messages:
Axel: Quick standup — did rolling restart of fleet in eu-west1 and ap-southeast-1. Hit increased spot evictions in ap-southeast-1 during warmup window. Noticed ~30% request failures for 2m. Raising here so ops sees it.
Mira: Thx. Did you capture the node-level logs? Last time evictions correlated with bursty reclaim events from cloud. If we keep using spot in APAC prewarm we should fallback to reserved on warmup.
Axel: Pasted CLI output from rwinctl below:
```
$ rwinctl fleet status --region ap-southeast-1 --filter=prewarm
nodes_total: 20
nodes_spot: 12
nodes_reserved: 8
spot_evictions_1h: 4
avg_prewarm_latency_ms: 420
```
Sam: FYI PR 1423 (region-aware-autoscaler) is in draft — Jean left comments. That PR changes scale-down cooldown and fallback policy.
Jean: @Sam I left comments, main thing is handling mixed spot/reserved counts when deciding fallback. I can finish review after standup, ping me on the thread.
InfraBot: deploy-canary: autoscaler-service v1.12.0 -> canary in ap-southeast-1 started by @ci (build 5822)
Mira: Let's hold spot prewarm for 30m in APAC until canary finishes. I'll open a quota/ops ticket to request temporary reserved capacity: GCP ticket GCP-78921.
Axel: Created internal runbook note and linked ticket. Action items: Mira -> open quota ticket (done), Jean -> finish review PR1423, Sam -> coordinate canary metrics (latency/errors), I'll keep prewarm paused in APAC for 30m. 
Sam: I'll attach a Grafana panel and post a short alert query: `sum(rate(prewarm_failures[5m])) by (region)`
Jean: SGTM :thumbsup:
Axel: thanks, will follow up in 30m with metrics. :eyes:
